quests.instruction: What is the action word for finding out how heavy something is?
quests.question: Weigh
quests.hint: Think about placing an apple on a scale to see its exact weight.
quests.explanation: Weigh means to find out how heavy something is. We weigh fruit on a scale at the store!
quests.funFact: A scale uses careful measurements to show exactly how heavy something is!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for planning the main points of something before writing it fully?
quests.question: Outline
quests.hint: Think about jotting down just the big ideas for a story before writing every sentence.
quests.explanation: Outline means to plan the main points before writing fully. We outline our story's big ideas first!
quests.funFact: Making an outline first can help a long story feel much easier to write!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking back at your work and making it better?
quests.question: Revise
quests.hint: Think about reading your story again and changing a few words to make it clearer.
quests.explanation: Revise means to look back at your work and make it better. We revise our story to make it clearer!
quests.funFact: Even famous authors revise their stories many times before they are finished!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully reading your writing to find small mistakes?
quests.question: Proofread
quests.hint: Think about reading your story one more time just to catch any spelling mistakes.
quests.explanation: Proofread means to carefully read writing to find small mistakes. We proofread our story to catch spelling mistakes!
quests.funFact: Reading your work out loud can help you proofread and catch more mistakes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking in books or online to learn true facts about something?
quests.question: Research
quests.hint: Think about looking through books at the library to learn all about dinosaurs.
quests.explanation: Research means to look for true facts about something. We research dinosaurs at the library!
quests.funFact: Researching a topic well can help you become a mini expert on it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for asking many people the same question to learn what they think?
quests.question: Survey
quests.hint: Think about asking your whole class what their favorite fruit is.
quests.explanation: Survey means to ask many people the same question. We survey our class about their favorite fruit!
quests.funFact: A survey can help you learn what a whole group of people thinks all at once!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for bringing many things or people together in one place?
quests.question: Gather
quests.hint: Think about bringing your whole family together in the living room for a game night.
quests.explanation: Gather means to bring things or people together. We gather our family for a fun game night!
quests.funFact: Gathering everyone together is the first step to having a wonderful time!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using less of something so it does not run out?
quests.question: Conserve
quests.hint: Think about turning off the water while you brush your teeth to save it.
quests.explanation: Conserve means to use less of something so it lasts. We conserve water by turning off the tap!
quests.funFact: Conserving water and energy is a great way to take care of our planet!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for keeping someone or something safe from harm?
quests.question: Protect
quests.hint: Think about wearing a helmet to keep your head safe while you ride your bike.
quests.explanation: Protect means to keep someone or something safe. We protect our heads with a helmet on our bike!
quests.funFact: A sturdy helmet helps protect your head if you ever take a tumble!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for keeping something safe so it lasts a long time?
quests.question: Preserve
quests.hint: Think about carefully keeping your favorite old drawing safe in a special folder.
quests.explanation: Preserve means to keep something safe so it lasts. We preserve our favorite drawings in a special folder!
quests.funFact: Museums work hard to preserve old, precious objects for everyone to enjoy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving a computer or robot instructions to follow?
quests.question: Program
quests.hint: Think about telling a small robot toy exactly which way to move.
quests.explanation: Program means to give a computer or robot instructions to follow. We program a small robot to move forward!
quests.funFact: Learning to program can help you build your very own simple games!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for writing special instructions that a computer can understand?
quests.question: Code
quests.hint: Think about typing special words and symbols that tell a computer exactly what to do.
quests.explanation: Code means to write special instructions for a computer. We code a simple game on the computer!
quests.funFact: Coding is like writing a very precise set of directions just for a computer!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for quickly pressing a button on a computer mouse?
quests.question: Click
quests.hint: Think about quickly pressing the button on a computer mouse to pick something.
quests.explanation: Click means to quickly press a button on a mouse. We click on a picture to open it!
quests.funFact: A single click can open a whole new page on the computer!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving a screen up or down to see more?
quests.question: Scroll
quests.hint: Think about sliding your finger up a screen to see more of a long page.
quests.explanation: Scroll means to move a screen up or down to see more. We scroll down to read more of a long page!
quests.funFact: Scrolling lets you see a page that is much longer than the screen itself!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sliding your finger quickly across a screen?
quests.question: Swipe
quests.hint: Think about sliding your finger sideways across a tablet to see the next picture.
quests.explanation: Swipe means to slide your finger quickly across a screen. We swipe to see the next picture!
quests.funFact: A quick swipe can move you to the very next page or picture instantly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sending a file from your device up to the internet?
quests.question: Upload
quests.hint: Think about sending your finished drawing from your tablet up onto a class website.
quests.explanation: Upload means to send a file up to the internet. We upload our finished drawing to the class website!
quests.funFact: Uploading lets you share your work with people far away in just a few seconds!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saving a file from the internet onto your device?
quests.question: Download
quests.hint: Think about saving a fun new game from the internet onto your tablet.
quests.explanation: Download means to save a file from the internet onto your device. We download a new game onto our tablet!
quests.funFact: Downloading brings something from the internet right onto your own device!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking for specific information online or in a book?
quests.question: Search
quests.hint: Think about typing a question into a computer to find the answer.
quests.explanation: Search means to look for specific information. We search online to find the answer to a question!
quests.funFact: Searching carefully with the right words helps you find answers much faster!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking through many pages or items without a fixed goal?
quests.question: Browse
quests.hint: Think about looking through many pages of a website just to see what is there.
quests.explanation: Browse means to look through many things without a fixed goal. We browse a website just to see what is there!
quests.funFact: Browsing lets you explore lots of information at your own relaxed pace!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for keeping a file so it is not lost when you close it?
quests.question: Save
quests.hint: Think about pressing a button so your drawing stays safe on the computer.
quests.explanation: Save means to keep a file so it is not lost. We save our drawing so it stays safe on the computer!
quests.funFact: Saving your work often helps make sure you never lose your hard work!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for removing something completely from a computer or device?
quests.question: Delete
quests.hint: Think about removing an old file you no longer need from a tablet.
quests.explanation: Delete means to remove something completely from a device. We delete old files we no longer need!
quests.funFact: Deleting old files can help keep your device neat and organized!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saving a sound or video so you can play it back later?
quests.question: Record
quests.hint: Think about pressing a button to save your voice singing a song.
quests.explanation: Record means to save a sound or video to play back later. We record our voice singing a favorite song!
quests.funFact: Recording a special moment lets you enjoy it again and again later!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for moving a video or song backward to watch or hear it again?
quests.question: Rewind
quests.hint: Think about moving a video back a little bit to watch your favorite part again.
quests.explanation: Rewind means to move a video or song backward. We rewind a video to watch our favorite part again!
quests.funFact: Rewinding lets you enjoy your favorite moment in a video as many times as you like!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for filling a device's battery with power?
quests.question: Charge
quests.hint: Think about plugging in your tablet overnight so it is ready in the morning.
quests.explanation: Charge means to fill a device's battery with power. We charge our tablet overnight so it is ready to use!
quests.funFact: A device with a full charge can last much longer before it needs power again!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for joining two things, or two people, together?
quests.question: Connect
quests.hint: Think about plugging one cord into another so a device can turn on.
quests.explanation: Connect means to join two things together. We connect a cord so our device can turn on!
quests.funFact: Connecting with a good friend can make any day so much more fun!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pulling a plug out to stop the flow of electricity?
quests.question: Unplug
quests.hint: Think about pulling a cord gently out of the wall when a device is not needed.
quests.explanation: Unplug means to pull a plug out to stop electricity. We unplug a device when we are finished using it!
quests.funFact: Unplugging devices you are not using can help save extra electricity!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing from one thing to another, like turning a light on or off?
quests.question: Switch
quests.hint: Think about flipping a small handle on the wall to turn a light on or off.
quests.explanation: Switch means to change from one thing to another. We switch the light on when a room gets dark!
quests.funFact: A light switch controls the flow of electricity with just a simple flip!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pushing down on a button firmly?
quests.question: Press
quests.hint: Think about pushing down firmly on a doorbell button.
quests.explanation: Press means to push down on a button firmly. We press the doorbell button when we visit a friend!
quests.funFact: Pressing a single button can start all sorts of amazing machines!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a small change to fix or improve something?
quests.question: Adjust
quests.hint: Think about turning a small dial to make music just a little bit louder.
quests.explanation: Adjust means to make a small change to improve something. We adjust the volume to make music just right!
quests.funFact: Making small adjustments often helps something work in exactly the right way!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for doing or saying something again?
quests.question: Repeat
quests.hint: Think about saying a new word one more time so you remember it well.
quests.explanation: Repeat means to do or say something again. We repeat a new word a few times to remember it!
quests.funFact: Repeating something you are learning helps your brain remember it much better!
